verses.restored: and you return to YHWH your Divine and listen to his voice according to all I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and all your soul/life,

original.text: וְשַׁבְתָּ֞ עַד יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֣ בְקֹל֔וֹ כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם אַתָּ֣ה וּבָנֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל נַפְשֶֽׁךָ

verses.restored: then YHWH your Divine will return your captivity/restore your fortunes and have compassion on you, and he will return and gather you from all peoples where YHWH your Divine scattered you.

familiar.text: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.

modern.text: then He will restore you from captivity and have compassion on you and gather you from all the nations to which the LORD your God has scattered you.

original.text: וְשָׁ֨ב יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ אֶת שְׁבוּתְךָ֖ וְרִחֲמֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁ֗ב וְקִבֶּצְךָ֙ מִכָּל הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֱפִֽיצְךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: If your scattered ones are at end of heavens, from there YHWH your Divine will gather you, and from there he will take you.

familiar.text: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:

modern.text: Even if you have been banished to the farthest horizon, He will gather you and return you from there.

original.text: אִם יִהְיֶ֥ה נִֽדַּחֲךָ֖ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם מִשָּׁ֗ם יְקַבֶּצְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וּמִשָּׁ֖ם יִקָּחֶֽךָ

verses.restored: YHWH your Divine will bring you into land your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it; he will do good to you and multiply you more than your fathers.

familiar.text: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

modern.text: And the LORD your God will bring you into the land your fathers possessed, and you will take possession of it. He will cause you to prosper and multiply more than your fathers.

original.text: וֶהֱבִֽיאֲךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֶל הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יָרְשׁ֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֥ וְהִרְבְּךָ֖ מֵאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ

familiar.text: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

modern.text: The LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants, and you will love Him with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.

translation_notes: Return/teshuvah follows even the full catastrophe of chapter 28; exile is not permanent rejection, and covenant continuity remains intact.
The phrase commonly rendered 'restore your fortunes' can also be heard as YHWH returning with the captivity, a major Jewish interpretive insight emphasizing Divine presence with the exiled.
Heart circumcision is an internal Jewish covenant metaphor and must never be used to supersede embodied Jewish circumcision or portray Judaism as merely external.
Verse 7's transfer of curses to persecutors is restoration rhetoric, not permission for private revenge or collective punishment.
The command is near—in mouth and heart—and does not require an inaccessible heavenly or overseas mediator.
'Choose life' is a communal covenant appeal, not a tool for blaming suicidal, depressed, ill, disabled, traumatized, or endangered people for circumstances beyond their control.
Life and death language must not be reduced to prosperity outcomes; it names a covenant orientation toward sustained communal life.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 30 for supersessionism, revenge, suicide blame, disability blame, prosperity theology, or coercive demands that traumatized people simply choose differently. Center return, compassion, gathering, accessibility of Torah, renewed heart, and the communal obligation to choose conditions in which people and descendants can live.
